# `page.create`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/page.create.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`page.create`: a new drawn page (FR-PAG-005, doc 06 §5.6).

The folio is `{section, number, label}` when `number` is given. Otherwise `after` names the page to
insert after and the folio is proposed (doc 06 §5.6): `after.number + 1` if it lies in the section's
range (any number when the page has no section) and no page, divider or report block of that section
uses it; else the sub-page `{after.number, label}` with label `k` (or `<after.label>.k`) for the
smallest free `k ≥ 1`. The section is `after`'s; a different explicit `section` is rejected.

Rejected: neither `number` nor `after`; a folio another page of the section already has; kind `report`
(report pages are generated, EW-INV-012). The section and form must exist.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `after` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) or `null` | no |  | The page to insert after, when the folio is proposed. |
| `form` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) or `null` | no |  | The frame form copy. |
| `grid` | [`CmdGrid`](#cmdgrid) | no | `{"den":3,"num":7937500}` | The wiring grid; default the QET 10 px grid. |

| `label` | [`CmdIdent`](#cmdident) or `null` | no |  | The label of an explicit folio (sub-pages). |
| `number` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) or `null` | no |  | An explicit folio number. |
| `section` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) or `null` | no |  | The section of an explicit folio. |
| `structure` | [`StructureAssignment`](#structureassignment) | no |  | The page's structure assignment. |
| `title` | [`CmdMlText`](#cmdmltext) | no |  | The page title. |

## Types

### CmdGrid

A rational grid step num/den in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2); num/den must be reduced and at least 1 nm.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `den` | integer (min 1, max 9007199254740991) | yes |  |  |
| `num` | integer (min 1, max 9007199254740991) | yes |  |  |

### CmdIdent

An identifier: non-empty, one line, NFC, without leading or trailing white space (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### CmdMlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags in ascending order with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

| `"single_line"` | Single-line diagram. |
| `"multi_line"` | Multi-line schematic. |
| `"overview"` | Overview. |
| `"bus_topology"` | Bus topology. |
| `"fluid"` | Fluid-power schematic. |
| `"assembly_overview"` | Assembly overview. |
| `"panel_layout"` | Panel layout. |
| `"model_view"` | 3D model view. |
| `"external_document"` | External document. |
| `"report"` | Report (generated only). |

### StructureAssignment

Which structure node a page, device or structure box belongs to, one slot per aspect (doc 03 §5).
Members follow the canonical aspect order of `ew_rds::Aspect`; the product aspect is the device tree and
has no slot.

```
use ew_schema::StructureAssignment;

let s: StructureAssignment = serde_json::from_str(
    r#"{"function":"7d2c95e0-1f4a-5b38-a6e7-0c93b5d1f284","location":"none"}"#,
).unwrap();
assert!(s.installation_site.is_none()); // absent: inherit
```

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `document_kind` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `&` (pages only). |
| `function` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `=` |
| `functional_assignment` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `==` |
| `installation_site` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `++` |
| `location` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `+` |
| `type` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `%` |
| `user_defined` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `#` |

### Slot

A structure slot: a structure node ID or "none"; absent means inherit (doc 05 §3.2).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: [`Uuid`](#uuid)

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: `"none"`

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); the lines before it stay committed. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
